3008-286647 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENTisenteredintoasofDecember QL, 2009 between NEW YORK CITY HOUSING AUTHORITY, a public benefit corporation established under the laws of the State of New York, having an office at 250 Broadway, New York, New York 10oo7, including any successor in interest or assigns by act of the Authority, or by operation of law, or otherwise ("Owner"); UNION GROVE HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND CORP., a not-for-profit corporation duly organized and existing under Article XI of the Private Housing Finance Law of the State of New York, having its principal office and place of business located at c/o MacQuesten Union Grove LLC, One North MacQuesten Parkway, Suite 100, Mount Vernon, New York 10550 ("Record Title Holder"); and, UNION GROVE ASSOCIATES, LLC, a limited liability company duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York, having its principal office and place of business located at c/o MacQuesten Union Grove LLC, One North MacQuesten Parkway, Suite 100, Mount Vernon, New York 10550 ("Beneficial Owner"”' and together with Record Title Holder, “Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of the Bronx, City and State of New York, known as Lots 2 and19 in Block 2988on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and commonly known as 1463 Vyse Avenue, Bronx, New York,and more particularly described on Exhibits“A’and "A-1" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Owner's Property" and said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements or additions thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the “Owner's Building"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of the Bronx, City and State of New York, known as Lot 4 in Block 2988 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known as 1468 Hoe Avenue, Bronx, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Developer's Property” and said buildings and Agreement, being called the “"Developer's Building"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the existing improvements on Developer's Property to construct thereon a new, approximately Seventy-Nine Thousand Seven Hundred and Nineteen Square Foot (79,719 sf) building, comprised of approximately Eighty-Four (84) units of affordable housing (such new building, as the same may be altered, modified, improved or replaced from time to time, the “New Building"); WHEREAS, it is planned that the New Building will contain Eighteen Thousand and Sixty-Seven Square Feet (18,067 sf) more Floor Area than is now permitted to be constructed on the Developer's Property pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, the Owner desires to convey and the Developer desires to acquire the Transferred Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) so as to permit the construction of the NewBuildings; NYC_MIDTOWN13743378161101.000
